questions.question: If 640 ÷ 8 + 930 ÷ 15 – k + 32 × 5 = 1104 ÷ 16 × 148 ÷ 37, then the value of k is:
questions.questionHtml: If 640 ÷ 8 + 930 ÷ 15 – k + 32 × 5 = 1104 ÷ 16 × 148 ÷ 37, then the value of k is:
questions.solution:
Given:

640 ÷ 8 + 930 ÷ 15 - k + 32 × 5 = 1104 ÷ 16 × 148 ÷ 37

Formula used:

Basic arithmetic operations: Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction

Calculation:

640 ÷ 8 + 930 ÷ 15 - k + 32 × 5 = 1104 ÷ 16 × 148 ÷ 37

⇒ 80 + 62 - k + 160 = 69 × 4

⇒ 302 - k = 276

⇒ k = 302 - 276

⇒ k = 26

∴ The correct answer is option (4).

questions.question: If \(\left[ {3\frac{6}{7}\, ÷ \,\frac{{54}}{7}\, - \,\left\{ {3\, - \,\left( {2\frac{3}{4}\, - \,\frac{3}{2}} \right)} \right\}} \right]\, \) + A ÷ 4 = 0, then what is the value of A?
questions.questionHtml: If \(\left[ {3\frac{6}{7}\, ÷ \,\frac{{54}}{7}\, - \,\left\{ {3\, - \,\left( {2\frac{3}{4}\, - \,\frac{3}{2}} \right)} \right\}} \right]\, \)+ A ÷ 4 = 0, then what is the value of A?
questions.solution:
Given:-

\(\left[ {3\frac{6}{7}\, ÷ \,\frac{{54}}{7}\, - \,\left\{ {3\, - \,\left( {2\frac{3}{4}\, - \,\frac{3}{2}} \right)} \right\}} \right]\, \)+ A ÷ 4 = 0

Concept used:- BODMAS 

Calculation:

 The expression could be written as:

⇒ \(\left[ {3\frac{6}{7}\, ÷ \,\frac{{54}}{7}\, - \,\left\{ {3\, - \,\left( {2\frac{3}{4}\, - \,\frac{3}{2}} \right)} \right\}} \right]+\frac{A}{4}=0\)

Solving the expression of () small bracket, 

⇒ \(\frac{11}{4}-\frac{3}{2}\) = \(\frac{5}{4}\)

Now the expression has become, 

⇒\(\left[ {3\frac{6}{7}\, ÷ \,\frac{{54}}{7}\, - \,\left\{ {3\, - \frac{5}{4}} \right\}} \right]+\frac{A}{4}=0\)

Solving the expression inside the curly braces {},

⇒ \(3-\frac{5}{4}=\frac{7}{4}\)

The simplified expression is,

⇒\(\left [3\frac{6}{7} \div \frac{54}{7}- \frac{7}{4}\right]+\frac{A}{4}=0~\)

Solving expression of rectangular bracket,

⇒ \(3\frac{6}{7} \div \frac{54}{7}- \frac{7}{4}\) = \(\frac{27}{7} \div \frac{54}{7}- \frac{7}{4}\)

⇒ \(\frac{27}{7} \times \frac{7}{54}- \frac{7}{4}\) =  \(\frac{1}{2}-\frac{7}{4}\)

⇒ \(\frac{-5}{4}\)

The expression is, 

⇒ \(\frac{-5}{4}+\frac{A}{4}=0\)

⇒ A = 5

∴ The value of A is 5.

questions.question: If 56 ÷ 4 + p × 3 – 24 ÷ 12 + 4 = 21 ÷ 3 + 3, then the value of p is:

56 ÷ 4 + p × 3 – 24 ÷ 12 + 4 = 21 ÷ 3 + 3,

14 + p × 3 – 2 + 4 = 7 + 3 ⇒ 16 + p × 3 = 10

p × 3 = -6 ⇒ p = -2

120 ÷ 15 of 4 + [11 × 4 ÷ 4 of {4 × 2 - (- 3)}]

questions.question: If m × 7 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 - 7 + 45 ÷ 5 × 4 + 49 = 87, then the value of m is:
questions.questionHtml: If m × 7 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 - 7 + 45 ÷ 5 × 4 + 49 = 87, then the value of m is:
questions.solution:
Given:

m × 7 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 - 7 + 45 ÷ 5 × 4 + 49 = 87

Formula Used:

Basic arithmetic operations (BODMAS rule)

Calculation:

m × 7 + 4 - 6 ÷ 3 - 7 + 45 ÷ 5 × 4 + 49 = 87

⇒ m × 7 + 4 - 2 - 7 + 36 + 49 = 87

⇒ m × 7 + 80 = 87

⇒ m × 7 = 7

⇒ m = 1

∴ The correct answer is option (3).

What is the value of \(\frac{\frac{5}{2}\div\frac{2}{5}\times \frac{1}{5}-\frac{1}{5}\div\frac{3}5{\times \frac{5}{2}}}{\frac{2}{5}\div\frac{1}{5}-\frac{1}{2}\times \frac{5}{2}\div\frac{25}{4}+\frac{1}{2}\div\frac{2}{5}\times\frac{1}{5}}?\)

Concept used:

⇒ \(\frac{\frac{5}{2}\times\frac{5}{2}\times \frac{1}{5}-\frac{1}{5}\times\frac{5}3{\times \frac{5}{2}}}{\frac{2}{5}\times\frac{5}{1}-\frac{1}{2}\times \frac{5}{2}\times\frac{4}{25}+\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{5}{2}\times\frac{1}{5}}\)

questions.question: The value of 264 ÷ 8 − 1 − 32 × 2 + 80 ÷ 5 × 40 ÷ 20 is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The value of 264 ÷ 8 - 1 - 32 × 2 + 80 ÷ 5 × 40 ÷ 20

Formula used:

Order of Operations (PEMDAS/BODMAS): Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication and Division (left to right), Addition and Subtraction (left to right)

Calculation:

264 ÷ 8 - 1 - 32 × 2 + 80 ÷ 5 × 40 ÷ 20

⇒ 33 - 1 - 32 × 2 + 80 ÷ 5 × 40 ÷ 20

⇒ 33 - 1 - 64 + 80 ÷ 5 × 40 ÷ 20

⇒ 33 - 1 - 64 + 16 × 40 ÷ 20

⇒ 33 - 1 - 64 + 640 ÷ 20

⇒ 33 - 1 - 64 + 32

⇒ 33 - 1 - 64 + 32

⇒ 32 - 64 + 32

⇒ -32 + 32

⇒ 0

∴ The correct answer is option (1).

questions.question: Simplify the expression: \(\frac{143 \times 143 + 143 \times 139 + 139 \times 139 }{143 \times143 \times 143 - 139 \times 139 \times139}\)
questions.solution:
\(\frac{143 \times 143 + 143 \times 139 + 139 \times 139 }{143 \times143 \times 143 - 139 \times 139 \times139}\)

⇒ \(\frac{143^2 + 143 \times 139 + 139^2 }{143^3 - 139^3}\)

⇒ \(\frac{143^2 + 143 \times 139 + 139^2}{(143 - 139)(143^2 + 143 \times 139 + 139^2)}\)

⇒ \(\frac{1}{(143 - 139)}\)

⇒ \(\frac{1}{4}\)

questions.question: Find the value of [16 ÷ 2 - 7 × 15 ÷ 3 + {(1 + 4) × 5} + 4 × 3 - 10].
questions.solution:
Given:

Find the value of [16 ÷ 2 - 7 × 15 ÷ 3 + {(1 + 4) × 5} + 4 × 3 - 10].

Formula used:

Follow the BODMAS rule (Bracket, Order, Division and Multiplication, Addition and Subtraction).

Calculation:

[16 ÷ 2 - 7 × 15 ÷ 3 + {(1 + 4) × 5} + 4 × 3 - 10]

⇒ [8 - 7 × 15 ÷ 3 + {5 × 5} + 4 × 3 - 10]

⇒ [8 - 7 × 5 + 25 + 12 - 10]

⇒ [8 - 35 + 25 + 12 - 10]

⇒ [8 - 35 + 37 - 10]

⇒ [45 - 45]

⇒ 0

∴ The correct answer is option (2).

questions.question: The value of 32 ÷ 12 of 3 × [5 - (15 - 12) ÷ 9] of \(\frac{3}{7}\) + 4 - 8 ÷ 2 of 4 is:
questions.questionHtml: The value of 32 ÷ 12 of 3 × [5 - (15 - 12) ÷ 9] of \(\frac{3}{7}\) + 4 - 8 ÷ 2 of 4 is:
questions.solution:
Concept Used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

Calculation:

 32 ÷ 12 of 3 × [5 –  (15 –  12) ÷ 9] of \(\frac{3}{7}\) + 4 –  8 ÷ 2 of 4 

⇒32 ÷ 12 of 3 × (5 – 3 ÷ 9) of 3/7 + 4 – 8 ÷ 2 of 4

⇒ 32 ÷ 12 of 3 × (5 – 1/3) of 3/7 + 4 – 8 ÷ 2 of 4

⇒ 32 ÷ 12 of 3 × 14/3 of 3/7 + 4 – 8 ÷ 2 of 4

⇒ 32 ÷ 12 of 3 × 2 + 4 – 8 ÷ 2 of 4

⇒ 32 ÷ 36 × 2 + 4 – 8 ÷ 2 of 4

⇒ 32 ÷ 36 × 2 + 4 – 8 ÷ 8

⇒ 32 ÷ 36 × 2 + 4 – 1

⇒ 16/9 + 4 – 1

⇒ 16/9 + 3

⇒ 43/9

⇒ \(4 \frac{7}{9}\)

∴ The required value is \(4 \frac{7}{9}\)

questions.question: If x is the square of the number when \((\frac{2}{5}of6\frac{1}{4} \div \frac{3}{7}) of 1\frac{2}{7}\) is divided by \(11\frac{1}{4}\) , then the value of 81x is:
questions.questionHtml: If x is the square of the number when \((\frac{2}{5}of6\frac{1}{4} \div \frac{3}{7}) of 1\frac{2}{7}\) is divided by \(11\frac{1}{4}\), then the value of 81x is:
questions.solution:
Given: 

Value of x is square of \((\frac{2}{5}of6\frac{1}{4} \div \frac{3}{7}) of 1\frac{2}{7}\)/ \(11\frac{1}{4}\)

Formula used:

Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below, 

Calculation:

Value of x is square of \((\frac{2}{5}of6\frac{1}{4} \div \frac{3}{7}) of 1\frac{2}{7}\)/ \(11\frac{1}{4}\)

⇒ \((\frac{2}{5}of6\frac{1}{4} \div \frac{3}{7}) of 1\frac{2}{7}\)/ \(11\frac{1}{4}\)

⇒ \((\frac{2}{5}of\frac{25}{4} \div \frac{3}{7}) of \frac{9}{7}\)/ \(\frac{45}{4}\)

⇒ \((\frac{5}{2} \div \frac{3}{7}) × \frac{9}{7}\)/ \(\frac{45}{4}\)

⇒ \(\frac{35}{6} × \frac{9}{7} \div \frac{45}{4}\)

⇒ \(\frac{35}{6} × \frac{9}{7} × \frac{4}{45}\)

⇒ 2/3

Value of x is square of 2/3 = 4/9

Value of 81x is 

⇒ 81 × (4/9) = 36

∴ value of 81x is 36

questions.question: The value of \({\frac{{{\textstyle{5 \over 2}} - {\textstyle{3 \over 7}} \times 1{\textstyle{4 \over 5}} \div 3{\textstyle{6 \over 7}}}}{{{\textstyle{3 \over 2}} + 1{\textstyle{2 \over 5}} \div 3{\textstyle{1 \over 2}} \times 1{\textstyle{1 \over 4}}}}}\) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

\({\frac{{{\textstyle{5 \over 2}} - {\textstyle{3 \over 7}} \times 1{\textstyle{4 \over 5}} \div 3{\textstyle{6 \over 7}}}}{{{\textstyle{3 \over 2}} + 1{\textstyle{2 \over 5}} \div 3{\textstyle{1 \over 2}} \times 1{\textstyle{1 \over 4}}}}}\)

Concept Used:

The concept of VBODMAS is used

1. V - Vinculum, 2. B- Bracket, O- Of, D- Divide, M- Multiply, A- Add, S- Subtract

Calculations:

⇒ \({\frac{{{\textstyle{5 \over 2}} - {\textstyle{3 \over 7}} \times 1{\textstyle{4 \over 5}} \div 3{\textstyle{6 \over 7}}}}{{{\textstyle{3 \over 2}} + 1{\textstyle{2 \over 5}} \div 3{\textstyle{1 \over 2}} \times 1{\textstyle{1 \over 4}}}}}\)

Here First, we have to solve the fractions part

⇒​ \({\frac{{{\textstyle{5 \over 2}} - {\textstyle{3 \over 7}} \times \textstyle{9\over5} \div {\textstyle{27 \over 7}}}}{{{\textstyle{3 \over 2}} + {\textstyle{7 \over 5}} \div {\textstyle{7 \over 2}} \times {\textstyle{5 \over 4}}}}}\)

Now, We have to solve the divide part

⇒​ \({\frac{{{\textstyle{5 \over 2}} - {\textstyle{3 \over 7}} \times \textstyle{9\over5} \times {\textstyle{7 \over 27}}}}{{{\textstyle{3 \over 2}} + {\textstyle{7 \over 5}} \times {\textstyle{2 \over 7}} \times {\textstyle{5 \over 4}}}}}\)

Now, we have to solve multiply parts

⇒​ \({\frac{{{\textstyle{5 \over 2}} - {\textstyle{1\over 5}} }}{{{\textstyle{3 \over 2}} + {\textstyle{1 \over 2}}}}}\)

⇒​ \({\frac{{{\textstyle{25-2 \over 10}} }}{{{\textstyle{3+1 \over 2}} }}}\)

⇒​ \({\frac{{{\textstyle{23 \over 10}} }}{{{\textstyle{4\over 2}} }}}\)

⇒​ \({{{\textstyle{23 \over 20}} }}=1\frac{3}{20}\)

⇒​ Hence, The value of the above equation is 1\(3\over20\)

\(% MathType!MTEF!2!1!+- % feaahqart1ev3aaatCvAUfeBSjuyZL2yd9gzLbvyNv2CaerbuLwBLn % hiov2DGi1BTfMBaeXatLxBI9gBaerbd9wDYLwzYbItLDharqqtubsr % 4rNCHbGeaGqiVu0Je9sqqrpepC0xbbL8F4rqqrFfpeea0xe9Lq-Jc9 % vqaqpepm0xbba9pwe9Q8fs0-yqaqpepae9pg0FirpepeKkFr0xfr-x % fr-xb9adbaqaaeGaciGaaiaabeqaamaabaabaaGcbaWaaSaaaeaaca % aIZaWaaSaaaeaacaaIXaaabaGaaGOmaaaacqGHRaWkcaaI1aWaaSaa % aeaacaaIXaaabaGaaGOmaaaacqGH3daUcaaIXaWaaSaaaeaacaaIXa % aabaGaaGOmaaaacqGHxdaTcaaI1aWaaSaaaeaacaaIXaaabaGaaGin % aaaacqGHsislcaaI1aWaaSaaaeaacaaIXaaabaGaaGOmaaaaaeaaca % aIXaWaaSaaaeaacaaIXaaabaGaaGOmaaaacqGHxdaTcaaIXaWaaSaa % aeaacaaIYaaabaGaaG4maaaacqGHsislcaaI2aWaaSaaaeaacaaIXa % aabaGaaGOmaaaaaaGaey49aGRaaG4naiabgEna0kaaikdaaaa!571E! \frac{{3\frac{1}{2} + 5\frac{1}{2} \div 1\frac{1}{2} \times 5\frac{1}{4} - 5\frac{1}{2}}}{{1\frac{1}{2} \times 1\frac{2}{3} - 6\frac{1}{2}}} \div 7 \times 2\)\(\frac{{3\frac{1}{2}\, + \,5\frac{1}{3}\, \div \,1\frac{1}{3}\, \times \,5\frac{1}{4}\, - \,5\frac{1}{2}}}{{1\frac{1}{2}\, \times \,1\frac{2}{3}\, - \,6\frac{1}{2}}}\, \div \,7\, \times \,2\)
questions.solution:
Given:

The given expression = \(\frac{{3\frac{1}{2}\, + \,5\frac{1}{3}\, \div \,1\frac{1}{3}\, × \,5\frac{1}{4}\, - \,5\frac{1}{2}}}{{1\frac{1}{2}\, × \,1\frac{2}{3}\, - \,6\frac{1}{2}}}\, \div \,7\, × \,2\)

Calculation:

\(\frac{{3\frac{1}{2}\, + \,5\frac{1}{3}\, \div \,1\frac{1}{3}\, × \,5\frac{1}{4}\, - \,5\frac{1}{2}}}{{1\frac{1}{2}\, × \,1\frac{2}{3}\, - \,6\frac{1}{2}}}\, \div \,7\, × \,2\)

= \(\frac{\frac{7}{2}+\frac{16}{3}\div\frac{4}{3}×\frac{21}{4}-\frac{11}{2}}{\frac{3}{2}×\frac{5}{3}-\frac{13}{2}}\div7×2\)

= \(\frac{\frac{7}{2}+\frac{16}{3}×\frac{3}{4}×\frac{21}{4}-\frac{11}{2}}{\frac{5}{2}-\frac{13}{2}}\div7×2\)

= \(\frac{\frac{7}{2}+21-\frac{11}{2}}{-4}\div7×2\)

= \(\frac{19}{-4}\div7×2\)

= (19/- 4) × (1/7) × 2

= - 19/14

= \(-1\frac{5}{14}\)

∴ The value of the expression is \(-1\frac{5}{14}\)
